Last updated: June 2026

Welcome to LISSE. By accessing our store or placing an order, you agree to these Terms of Service. Please read them alongside our Privacy Policy, Shipping & Returns and Refund Policy, which form part of these Terms. If you don’t agree, please don’t use the site.

Using the site

You agree to use the site lawfully and not to disrupt it, gain unauthorised access, scrape it, post false reviews, resell our products without authorisation, or infringe the rights of others. You’re responsible for keeping your account details accurate and secure. We may update, suspend or discontinue features at any time.

Our products are cosmetics

LISSE Firming Body Oil is a cosmetic for external use on the skin only — not a drug or medical treatment, and we make no medical claims. It’s fragrance-free, vegan, cruelty-free, dermatologist-tested and non-comedogenic. Descriptions refer to the look and feel of skin, and results vary. Patch-test before first use and stop if irritation occurs. LISSE is loved during and after pregnancy, but please check with your doctor first if you’re pregnant, nursing, or managing a skin condition.

Orders & pricing

All orders are subject to acceptance and availability. Prices are in US dollars and may change at any time, but changes won’t affect orders we’ve already accepted. We reserve the right to refuse, limit or cancel any order — including for suspected fraud or obvious pricing or typographical errors — and will refund any payment already taken if we do.

Subscriptions & billing

Subscribe & Save plans renew automatically at the price and schedule shown when you signed up, until you change or cancel them. By subscribing, you authorise us to charge your payment method each cycle. You can skip, reschedule or cancel anytime from your account before your next dispatch — no fees or commitments.

Shipping, guarantee & returns

Delivery times and costs are set out in our Shipping & Returns policy. Risk of loss passes to you once your order is handed to the carrier, but if a parcel is lost or damaged we’ll make it right. Purchases are backed by our 90-day money-back promise and governed by our Refund Policy — you keep the bottle, so there’s no need to ship it back.

Intellectual property & liability

All content on this site — the LISSE name, logo, text, images and design — belongs to LISSE or its licensors and may not be copied or reused without our written permission. The site and products are provided "as is" to the fullest extent permitted by law; LISSE is not liable for indirect, incidental or consequential losses, and our total liability for any claim is limited to the amount you paid for the order. Nothing here limits your rights under applicable consumer law.

Governing law, changes & contact

These Terms are governed by the laws of the State of California, USA. We may revise them from time to time; the "last updated" date above reflects the current version, and continued use means you accept the updated Terms. Questions? Visit our contact page or email hello@lisse.com and we’ll reply within one business day.
